essential: Play the original VVVVVV. Move through Space Station 1, surviving spikes. Positive x is right and y down, in pixels; a tile is 8 pixels. Flip reverses gravity only on the ground/roof. Each action holds movement for 15 native ticks; flip is a single edge at tick 2. The game pauses while deciding. gravity=0 down,1 up. local rows: # solid, ! static spike, . clear, ? outside room; rows start at localOriginTiles, each is 9 cells. entities are visible room objects [native type,x,y,width,height,harmful]. Head toward the next room; avoid dying.

criteria.flip: Flip gravity once if touching ground or roof.
criteria.flip_left: Move left and flip gravity once.
criteria.flip_right: Move right and flip gravity once.
